posts.author: AARATECH
posts.content:
WE’RE HIRING – BUSINESS ANALYST
AaraTech is looking for a motivated and analytical Business Analyst to join our team!
Are you passionate about understanding business needs, gathering requirements, analyzing data, and delivering effective solutions? This is an opportunity to turn business challenges into clear requirements and impactful results.
POSITION: Business Analyst
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
• Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear functional requirements.
• Create user stories, use cases, and process documentation.
• Analyze existing business processes and identify areas for improvement.
• Develop process maps and workflows to support business objectives.
• Work with stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment.
• Use data and SQL queries to support analysis and informed decision-making.
• Collaborate with project teams to support solution delivery.
KEY SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS
• Requirements Gathering and Analysis
• SQL and Data Analysis
• Business Process Mapping
• Stakeholder Communication
• Documentation and Reporting
• Problem-Solving and Critical Thinking
• Functional and Business Analysis
• Cross-Functional Collaboration
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to understand business challenges and recommend practical solutions.
• Good knowledge of business processes and requirements documentation.
• Ability to work effectively with business and technical teams.
READY FOR YOUR NEXT CAREER OPPORTUNITY?
Join AaraTech and help transform business needs into meaningful solutions.
Apply now by sending your updated resume to:
Email: recruiter@aaratechinc.com
Website: www.aaratech.com
Take the next step in your Business Analyst career with AaraTech!

posts.author: Glen D'Souza
posts.content:
We are looking for a Power BI Specialist in Bangalore !!
Not just someone who can build dashboards.
We need someone who can own the complete BI lifecycle, from SQL and data modelling through DAX, visualization, refresh automation, troubleshooting and business adoption.
Core skills we are looking for:
-Power BI Desktop & Service
-Advanced DAX & Power Query
-Strong SQL & Data modelling
-ERP/CRM data integration
-Gateways & scheduled refresh
-Row-Level Security
-Dashboard performance optimization
-Data validation & troubleshooting
-Strong business understanding
-Integrating AI-driven insights
-Developing natural-language Q&A and conversational analytics experiences
-Exploring AI-assisted forecasting
🎓 PL-300 certification and exposure to Microsoft Fabric .

Apply or share this post with someone who would be a great fit. share your CV with  parthiban.moorthy@centena.com.

🚀 WE ARE HIRING | QA ANALYST | DUBAI, UAE
We are looking for an experienced QA Analyst to join our team for an exciting onsite opportunity in Dubai.
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💼 Experience: 4+ Years
🏢 Work Mode: Onsite
Key Requirements:
4+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Testing.
Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
Experience in preparing and executing test cases and test scenarios.
Knowledge of Functional, Regression, Integration and UAT Testing.
Ability to identify, document, track and report defects.
Good understanding of defect management and QA processes.
Strong analytical and communication skills.
📩 Interested candidates: Share your updated resume via DM or email.
